items.source:
This will return the type of a simple property or the component type of a
collection like property.
items.translation: 这将返回简单属性的类型，或集合型属性的组件类型。

items.source: The name of the attribute of the mapped class.
The name of the property as stored in the graph.
Flag, if this is a composite property.
items.translation: 如果是复合属性，请标记此标志。

items.source: True if this property is the id property.
items.translation: 如果此属性是标识符属性，则返回 true。

items.source: Flag, if this is an internal id property.
items.translation: 如果这是内部 ID 属性，请标记。

items.source: Flag, if this is a relationship.
items.translation: 若此为一段关系，请标记。

items.source: Associations between different node types can be queried on the Schema itself.
items.translation: 可以在Schema本身查询不同类型节点之间的关联。

items.source:
Spring Data's persistent properties have slightly different semantics. They have an
entity centric approach of properties. Spring Data properties contain - if not marked
otherwise - also associations.
items.translation: Spring Data 的持久化属性具有略微不同的语义。它们采用以实体为中心的属性方法，除非另有标记，否则 Spring Data 属性还包含关联关系。

items.source: the name of the attribute of the mapped class
the name of the property as stored in the graph
true if this property is the id property
items.translation: 如果此属性是标识符属性，则返回 true。

items.source: true, if this property is the id property and the owner uses internal ids
items.translation: 如果此属性是标识符属性且所有者使用内部标识符，则为 true。

items.source: whether this property describes a relationship or not.
items.translation: 该属性是否描述了一种关系。

items.source:
true if the entity's property (this object) is stored as multiple
properties on a node or relationship.
items.translation: 如果实体的属性（此对象）在节点或关系上存储为多个属性，则为 true。

items.source:
Provides minimal information how to map class attributes to the properties of a node or
a relationship.
items.translation: 提供有关如何将类属性映射到节点或关系的属性的最少信息。
